description: Get a link to the marketingburos.nl page that shows 2-3 agencies side by side: place, team size, specialisms, cases and what their own site says. Takes slugs from search_agencies, match_brief or find_agency, in the order to show them. Returns compare_url plus name, city and profile_url per agency; slugs without a public profile are listed in not_found. Returns isError with {error:'not_enough_agencies'} when fewer than 2 public agencies remain.

slugs.description: 2-3 agency slugs from search_agencies, match_brief or find_agency, in the order to show them.

name: compare_agencies
title: Compare agencies side by side
